channel.title: Gradle incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Gradle's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Failed upgrade on the Plugin Portal [resolved]
item.description:
While trying to deploy an upgrade, the application was down for 20 minutes from 11:19 GMT+2.
We will investigate the root cause and attempt the upgrade at a later date.

item.title: Plugin portal unreachable due to Cloudflare having issues [resolved]
Connection issues on the Gradle Plugin Portal [resolved]
item.description:
The plugin portal suffered connection issues possibly related to incidents with the different providers used: * Heroku: https://status.heroku.com/incidents/2867 * AWS: https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status?eventID=arn:aws:health:us-east-1::event/INTERNETCONNECTIVITY/AWS_INTERNETCONNECTIVITY_OPERATIONAL_ISSUE/AWS_INTERNETCONNECTIVITY_OPERATIONAL_ISSUE_49824_16DD211EFC1
When restarted, the application started behaving properly.

item.title: Gradle distribution downloads are failing [resolved]
item.description:
services.gradle.org is fully operational again.
The outage was caused by a configuration change on services.gradle.org that was not intended to affect this service.
